card.title: How To Fix an iPhone 11 Pro That Randomly Restarts

source.title: How To Fix an iPhone 11 Pro That Randomly Restarts

claims.statement: On iPhone 11 Pro / Pro Max, check the panic-full log's Missing sensors list.
TG0B or TG0V means battery: failed battery, damaged connector or missing battery data line (check the PMU_TO_BATTERY_SWI pin in diode mode).
Prs0 or Mic1 means the charging port flex (also check resistors around its connector).
Mic2 means the microphone on the power button flex, often damaged during back glass work.
The required flexes must be connected; unplugging a suspect flex does not help troubleshoot because the phone will restart without it.

procedure: Open newest panic-full log and read Missing sensors.
TG0B/TG0V: known-good battery, inspect connector, diode-check PMU_TO_BATTERY_SWI.
Prs0/Mic1: known-good charging port flex, check nearby resistors.
Mic2: known-good power button flex, check components near its connector.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
card.component: Battery / charge port flex / power button flex
